content:
Field Name
Description
MobileDetectionId
ID of the mobile detection.
BasicIntegrity
The result of a more lenient verdict for device integrity. Returned by Google SafetyNet Attestation API.
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
CTSProfileMatch
The result of a stricter verdict for device integrity. Returned by Google SafetyNet Attestation API.
IsEcho
Indicates if the same event was sent before.
PatternId
The ID of the detection for this event.
SafetyNetAdvice
Provides information to help explain why the Google SafetyNet Attestation API set either CTSProfileMatch or BasicIntegrity
fields to false.
SafetyNetErrorMessage
An encoded error message. Returned by Google SafetyNet Attestation API.
SafetyNetErrorType
Describes SafetyNet error. Error could have multiple reasons. Values:
PARSE_ERROR (1)
PROFILE_MATCH_FAILED (2)
BASIC_INTEGRITY_FAILED (3)
NONCE_INVALID (4)
APK_PACKAGE_NAME_INVALID (5)
APK_CERTIFICATE_INVALID (7)
SIGNATURE_INVALID (10)
CERTIFICATE_INVALID (11)
SafetyNetEvaluationType
Provides information about the type of measurements used to compute fields like CTSProfileMatch and BasicIntegrity.
